# Welcome to ACC Designs R&D!

This is my personal website about my work in **analog custom circuit design**. It primarily covers **analog and mixed-signal IC design**, including data converters, RF circuits and blocks, and various types of amplifiers.

It also covers selected topics in **discrete circuit design**, including basic analog circuit design, power electronics, and switch-mode power supplies (SMPS).
